abstract: Tracks secondary freight market sentiment and fixture price indexing
system_message:
You are Commercial brokerage analyst (CBA). You serve as the Commercial brokerage analyst (CBA), responsible for tracking secondary freight market sentiment and fixture price indexing across commercial charter proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks secondary freight market sentiment and fixture price indexing（INDEX）
information_points.content:
CBA-INDEX-RZU：Based on the quarterly short-sea chartering panel survey among participating container cargo owners and freight forwarders, Nordic Blue Coastal Express registers a regional charterer satisfaction index of 78 points on a normalized 100-point composite scale.
CBA-INDEX-6YA：In the quarterly short-sea chartering panel survey evaluating responses from participating container cargo owners and freight forwarders, Baltic Hydrogen Carrier Syndicate achieved a regional charterer satisfaction index of 92 points on a normalized 100-point composite commercial satisfaction scale.
CBA-INDEX-P9V：According to the quarterly short-sea chartering panel survey of participating container cargo owners and freight forwarders, North Sea Feeder Alliance holds a regional charterer satisfaction index of 78 points on a normalized 100-point composite commercial satisfaction scale.

information_points.title: Spot market spot fixtures（SPOT）
information_points.content:
CBA-SPOT-OA6：Baltic exchange charter fixture recaps for regional spot voyage fixtures executed during the current calendar quarter report a short-sea spot day rate of 18000 USD/day as the clean time-charter equivalent operating rate for North Sea Feeder Alliance.
CBA-SPOT-WTN：Regional spot voyage fixtures from the Baltic exchange charter recap executed during the current calendar quarter show a short-sea spot day rate of 22000 USD/day in clean time-charter equivalent operating terms for Baltic Hydrogen Carrier Syndicate.
CBA-SPOT-VGA：Fixture records from the Baltic exchange charter recap covering regional spot voyages executed during the current calendar quarter indicate a short-sea spot day rate of 14000 USD/day for Nordic Blue Coastal Express.
